verdict.rationale: Render documents an official CLI for managing services from the terminal, including non-interactive use in scripts and CI/CD, so command-line operation is a first-party capability. However, no evidence explicitly shows a CLI deploy or trigger-deploy command, or creating a new service from the CLI; the only explicit trigger_deploy tool is in the MCP server, for existing services. missing for 10: explicit CLI deploy/trigger command documentation, evidence that initial project/service creation works without the dashboard, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my project directly from the command line without using a web dashboard

citations.quote: Use the Render CLI to manage your Render services and datastores directly from your terminal
The CLI also supports [non-interactive use](#non-interactive-mode) in scripts and CI/CD.
The Render CLI can manage services, Render Postgres databases, and Render Key Value instances.
